_what: Experimentally supported aggregation-critical regions. The validation set.
_why: A benchmark of aggregation predictors is only as sound as the ground truth it scores against. Nothing in this project is sounder than this table, so it carries provenance per row rather than per file.

_columns._note: THE THIRTEEN FIELDS BELOW ARE PRESENT ON EVERY ROW AND ARE THE STABLE SCHEMA. Anything else on a row is per-row commentary: useful, but not enumerable and not to be relied on by code. _columns.protein: Protein name as used in the source literature. Not an accession -- see `frame` for the numbering frame and accession where one is recorded.
_columns.residues: The region, in the frame named by `frame`. Usually 'start-end'; occasionally a compound or descriptive string, so PARSE DEFENSIVELY.
_columns.construct: WHICH CONSTRUCT established it. A region can be necessary in one construct and dispensable in another, and both results can be correct. Without this column the benchmark scores against a moving target.
_columns.found_by: How the region was DISCOVERED. Rows found by prediction are CIRCULAR for a predictor benchmark and are analysed separately.
_columns.source: Full citation of the paper the row rests on.
_columns.verified_against_publisher_pdf: false means nobody has opened the source and checked this row. WHERE THIS DISAGREES WITH `source_version`, source_version GOVERNS -- it is stricter and more informative.
_columns.circularity_status: CLEAN | CIRCULAR | UNDECIDABLE. Whether a predictor was in the DISCOVERY path. See _SCHEMA_CIRCULARITY.
_columns.circularity_basis: Written justification for circularity_status. Prose, always present, never inferable from a keyword -- see _circularity_cannot_be_grepped.
_columns.stratum: DISCORDANT | DISCORDANT_DERIVED | DISCORDANT_PROVISIONAL | CONCORDANT | PENDING. Whether experiment and prediction AGREE on this region. Distinct from circularity: circularity is about discovery, stratum is about outcome. See _SCHEMA_STRATUM.
_columns.stratum_basis: Written justification for stratum, naming the tools and quoting the source where the assignment is documented.
_columns.source_version: version_of_record | author_manuscript | pmc_full_text | preprint | source_not_opened | UNRECORDED. WHICH VERSION of the source was actually opened. See _SCHEMA_SOURCE_VERSION.
_columns.source_version_note: Written justification for source_version, including citability under PREREGISTRATION.md 12.1 decision 3.
_columns.cpad_status: Training-set contamination check against CPAD 2.0, required by PREREGISTRATION §5.2b item 4 and completed 17 Nov 2026 against ALL THREE CPAD datasets (APR protein list, peptide table, structures table), each read in full. THIS IS A THIRD KIND OF CIRCULARITY, distinct from `circularity_status` (a predictor in the DISCOVERY path) and from `stratum` (experiment-prediction AGREEMENT): it is training-set membership of the benchmark row itself. VALUES. `CPAD_MEMBER`: the protein appears in at least one CPAD 2.0 dataset, so an AggrescanAI hit on this row may be recall of training data rather than prediction; EXCLUDED from the primary confirmatory statistic under §5.2b item 5. `CPAD_ABSENT_ORTHOLOGY_CHECKED`: absent from all three datasets AND absent from the protein's orthologous group in both OMA and OrthoInspector -- the two sources CPAD90 transfers homologues from -- with human in-paralogues checked individually. This is the strongest statement public sources support; it is NOT a certificate, because the CPAD90 membership list is unpublished. `TRAINING_SET_UNCERTAIN`: defined by §5.2b item 4 for a protein that is itself absent but has a homologue in CPAD. NO ROW CURRENTLY CARRIES IT -- the one candidate, hnRNPA1, resolved to outright membership once the structures table was read. See _CPAD_MEMBERSHIP_CHECK_2026-11-17, and note its warning that checking a single CPAD dataset would have cleared hnRNPA1 and LECT2 wrongly.
_columns.cpad_basis: The written evidence for `cpad_status` on this row: which CPAD table the protein was found in or absent from, under which name or accession, and what remains unresolved. Written per row for the same reason `circularity_basis` is -- a one-word status that cannot be audited is not provenance.
_columns.cpad_checked: Date the CPAD 2.0 membership check was run for this row (ISO 8601).

regions.SUFFICIENCY_IS_EXPLICITLY_NEGATIVE: THE PAPER IS CLEAR THAT THE REGION IS NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT, which the construct column must carry. "The N-terminal region plus CC1-2 did not aggregate however (aa 1-382; Fig. 11G), demonstrating that although this 25-aa linker region is ESSENTIAL for aggregation to occur, IT IS NOT IN ITSELF SUFFICIENT to induce aggregation, requiring the presence of at least some other part of the central domain." Necessity is shown two ways: 324-652 aggregates while 349-652 does not (Figs 10E/10F, confirmed by insoluble-fraction Western blot, Fig 11A), and 190-652 aggregates while 190-652 delta-324-348 does not (Figs 11E/11F). Quantified blind: three constructs containing the region average at least 1.3 aggregates per cell versus 0.1 or less for two lacking it, p < 0.001 by one-way ANOVA with Bonferroni correction.
regions.THE_FIFTH_AND_MOST_DIRECT_PRE_EMPTION_OF: THE ORIGINAL AUTHORS MADE THE GATEKEEPER OBSERVATION THEMSELVES, IN 2017, ON THIS EXACT REGION. Discussion p.9591: "The 25-aa region CONTAINS MULTIPLE PROLINE RESIDUES (Fig. 12B), suggesting that it likely represents a TURN between CC1 and CC2. It is also RICH IN CHARGED AMINO ACIDS, allowing for the possibility that TRIOBP-1 aggregation is dependent on protein-protein interactions." Figure 12B colours the prolines purple and the charges red and blue, exactly the two residue classes this project counts. COMPUTED FROM THEIR PRINTED SEQUENCE: 4 prolines + 8 charged = 12/25 = 48.0%, reproducing our headline figure from the source. SO THE QUALITATIVE OBSERVATION IS THEIRS AND HAS BEEN IN PRINT SINCE 2017. What this project added was the QUANTIFICATION and the comparison against deposited steric zippers -- and H3 was already retired on 16 Nov (PREREGISTRATION 9.1) for other reasons. This confirms that retirement was correct and shows the claim was even less novel than the retirement assumed. THEY ALSO OFFER A MECHANISM WE DID NOT: a turn, plus a protein-protein interaction site. Their reading is that the region matters because other proteins bind there, not because of its own aggregation propensity -- "That this region was not strongly predicted to have an innate aggregation propensity might further implicate the involvement of additional proteins or other cellular factors in the aggregation process". THAT IS A LIVE ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS TO H4 AND MUST BE STATED ALONGSIDE IT.

Tsiolaki et al. 2019 (J Struct Biol 207:260) ran AMYLPRED2, an 11-method consensus, over the whole LECT2 sequence BEFORE any structure existed, and nominated two aggregation-prone regions: 38-58 and 73-88. The cryo-EM core determined four years later is 55-75. COMPUTED OVERLAP: only 7 of the 21 core residues were predicted, and those seven are the two ENDS (55-58 and 73-75). THE ENTIRE 14-RESIDUE CENTRE, 59-72 (QEKPYQNKNAINNG), WAS NOT PREDICTED. AND THE MISSED STRETCH IS THE STRUCTURALLY IMPORTANT ONE. Richards 2023 names the residues that hold the core together: the polar ladders Q59, N65, N67 and N71, the central I69 that "anchors the very center of the fibril core", and the G58/G72 pair. regions.THE_EX_VIVO_CONFLICT_THAT_LIMITS_THIS_RO: A COMPANION CRYO-EM STUDY OF PATIENT MATERIAL REPORTS A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT CORE. 'Structural polymorphism of ex-vivo ALECT2 amyloid fibrils' (PMC13247027), from the kidney of a patient homozygous for I40V, reports that ALL 133 RESIDUES of mature LECT2 are incorporated into the fibril structure. This recombinant structure gives a 21-residue core; the patient structure gives a whole-protein core. The authors of the recombinant work flagged the risk themselves: 'It remains to be seen whether recombinant LECT2 amyloid fibrils exactly match those present in the kidneys of ALECT2 patients.' THEY DO NOT APPEAR TO. This row therefore records a RECOMBINANT core that may be an in vitro artefact, and it must never be described as the ALECT2 disease core. It is the sharpest construct-dependence case in the whole set -- sharper than TRIOBP-1 324-328 or TDP-43 RRM2 -- because the disagreement is 21 residues versus 133.

regions.construct: NO CONSTRUCT, AND NOT RECOMBINANT -- WHICH CUTS BOTH WAYS. Native protein: defatted soybean flour -> soybean protein isolate -> glycinin fraction (pH 4.8 precipitation) -> dissociated into acidic (glycinin-A) and basic (glycinin-B) subunits by 90 C / 30 min in 30 mM Tris-HCl, 15 mM beta-mercaptoethanol, pH 8.0, then pH precipitation, dialysis (MWCO 3.5 kDa), lyophilisation. Fibrillisation: "Protein solutions (20 mg mL-1, pH 2.0) were heated at 90 C for 12 h under constant magnetic stirring (500 rpm)". || THREE CONSTRUCT CAVEATS, ALL MATERIAL. (1) THE STARTING MATERIAL IS A MIXTURE, NOT A PROTEIN. "glycinin-A" is the pooled acidic subunits of at least five glycinin gene products (G1-G5); the paper reports ">90% purity" of the FRACTION, which is a statement about the absence of other soy proteins, not about which glycinin gene is in it. (2) THE FIBRIL-FORMING SPECIES WAS NEVER WEIGHED OR SEQUENCED. SDS-PAGE was run on the starting fractions (Figure 1a) and NOT on the fibrils; there is no mass spectrometry anywhere in the paper -- grep of the full text returns 0 hits for "mass spec" and 0 for "hydroly". So whether the fibrils contain intact acidic subunit or chain fragments is not addressed. 12 h at pH 2.0 and 90 C is a condition under which acid hydrolysis of the backbone would be expected, and for other food proteins fibrillation under exactly this protocol is reported to proceed via hydrolysis-generated peptides -- BUT THAT IS BACKGROUND, NOT A SOURCE OPENED HERE, and is recorded as an open question, not as a finding. (3) pH 2.0 AND 90 C IS A DENATURING CONDITION the paper itself labels as such ("fibrils formed under denaturing conditions (90 C, pH 2.0)"). Nothing here speaks to aggregation at physiological pH.

regions.A_SIGNAL_PEPTIDE_IN_THE_SCORED_FRAME_BIA: A SCORING DECISION THIS ROW FORCES, WRITTEN DOWN BEFORE THE ROW IS SCORED RATHER THAN AFTER. Nothing has been run on this protein yet, so this is a pre-registration of the frame, not a rationalisation of a number. || THE CHOICE. P02858's 563-residue precursor comprises signal peptide 1-23, A5 24-120, A4 121-378 and B3 379-563. Scoring the 563-residue precursor would put the SIGNAL PEPTIDE into the window pool: MGKPFTLSLSSLCLLLLSSACFA, 23 residues of almost unbroken hydrophobicity. Every aggregation predictor in both arms scores such a stretch highly, and correctly -- signal peptides are hydrophobic because they must thread a translocon, not because they aggregate. Under 3.1, P is the fraction of windows in the protein scoring at or below the region's best window, so each spuriously high-scoring decoy window LOWERS P and RAISES v, pushing the verdict toward "the predictor failed". A region can be made to look missed by choosing a frame that includes a hydrophobic segment that is not in the sample. || THE DECISION: SCORE THE A4 ACIDIC CHAIN, P02858 121-378, 258 residues, with the region at 164-190 renumbered to 44-70 locally. Grounds: (a) it is the only one of the four pieces that was in the fibrillation tube -- the signal peptide is cleaved co-translationally, B3 is the basic subunit the paper shows does NOT fibrillise, and A5 is a separate chain; (b) it excludes the signal-peptide decoy; (c) it follows the precedent already set for serum amyloid A and LECT2, both of which are scored on mature chains. _COAGGREGATION_IS_THREE_DIFFERENT_PHENOM: ADDED 15 Nov 2026. The word 'co-aggregation' names at least THREE unrelated things, and all three surface in searches this project runs. (1) PROTEIN hetero-aggregation -- two misfolded proteins forming mixed oligomers or fibrils. This is the only sense this project means. (2) EPIDEMIOLOGICAL / FAMILIAL co-aggregation -- diagnoses clustering in families. Liu F-C et al., Clin Epidemiol 10:631-641 (2018) is titled 'Familial aggregation of Parkinson's disease and COAGGREGATION WITH NEUROPSYCHIATRIC DISEASES' and reports raised SCHIZOPHRENIA risk in first-degree relatives of PD patients. Any query pairing 'coaggregation' with 'schizophrenia' will return this literature, which is population genetics and says nothing about protein structure. See also Feldman et al., Eur J Epidemiol 29:49-56 (2014), 'modest familial co-aggregation between dementia and parkinsonism'. (3) BACTERIAL coaggregation -- specific adhesion between genetically distinct bacterial cells in biofilms, mediated by lectin-saccharide interactions. Nothing to do with amyloid. As of 15 Nov 2026 this repository is clean of senses (2) and (3); keep it that way, and label the sense whenever the word is used.

_SCHEMA_CIRCULARITY.added: 16 Nov 2026, by author decision: KEEP CIRCULAR ROWS, LABELLED, rather than dropping them. A benchmark that ships its contaminated rows with the contamination documented is more useful to other people than one that silently excludes them -- and the exclusions turned out to be the best-evidenced part of the work.
_SCHEMA_CIRCULARITY.circularity_status: CLEAN | CIRCULAR | UNDECIDABLE. CLEAN: the region was localised by truncation, deletion, substitution or an unbiased screen with NO aggregation predictor and no sequence/compositional heuristic in the DISCOVERY path. CIRCULAR: a predictor or sequence heuristic nominated the region and experiment then tested it. UNDECIDABLE: discovery path not recoverable from sources read.
_SCHEMA_CIRCULARITY.the_rule_that_makes_this_workable: PREDICTION USED AFTER MAPPING DOES NOT CONTAMINATE. A post-hoc predictor run on an already-mapped region is a mechanistic check, not a selection step. This is what keeps DISC1 384-415 clean despite Zaharija 2025 running five predictors on DISC1.
_SCHEMA_CIRCULARITY.circularity_is_TOOL_SPECIFIC: A region nominated by AmylPred2 is circular for AmylPred2 and for any consensus containing it, but a tool that did not exist at the time is being tested fairly on it. Circular rows may therefore serve as LABELLED POSITIVE CONTROLS for the modern arm -- with the selection bias stated, since a region legacy tools ranked top is predictable by construction and cannot test whether modern tools recover what legacy MISSED.
_SCHEMA_CIRCULARITY.how_these_rows_are_analysed: Separately, always, per CLAUDE.md. CIRCULAR rows are excluded from the primary statistic and reported as their own stratum. They are never silently pooled with CLEAN rows.

_SCHEMA_STRATUM.added: 16 Nov 2026, required by the PREREGISTRATION.md 7 amendment.
_SCHEMA_STRATUM.why: WIDENING THE SET MOSTLY ADDS TRUE POSITIVES, AND A TRUE POSITIVE CANNOT DISCRIMINATE MODERN FROM LEGACY PREDICTORS BECAUSE BOTH HIT IT. A region gets mapped cleanly and early precisely when it is a classic short hydrophobic or beta-prone motif -- which is what the predictors were built to detect -- so the literature is enriched for regions the predictors find. Power lives only where experiment and prediction DISAGREE.

values.DISCORDANT: Experiment and prediction disagree. THE PRIMARY STATISTIC IS COMPUTED ON THIS STRATUM ONLY.

_ANUPP_IS_PRIOR_ART_ON_H1.why_it_matters: CLAUDE.md's headline question is 'Do MODERN aggregation predictors recover the experimentally mapped regions of DISC1 and TRIOBP-1 that the 2004-2010 generation missed?' FOR DISC1, A PARTIAL ANSWER IS ALREADY IN PRINT, AND IT IS YES. This is not a pre-emption of PREREGISTRATION 5.2, which claims only that no PROTEIN LANGUAGE MODEL has been run on DISC1 or TRIOBP-1 -- ANuPP is not a PLM, and that claim survives. The open questions it leaves are the ones worth asking: (1) does the PLM generation recover it, which nobody has tested; (2) does ANuPP's success GENERALISE to TRIOBP-1 324-348 and FUS 39-95, or was DISC1 a single lucky hit -- ANuPP has NOT been run on TRIOBP-1, and the thesis contains no TRIOBP-1 predictor runs at all; (3) ANuPP is a 2021 tool and sits in neither the frozen legacy arm nor the modern arm, which is now an obvious gap in the design.

PREREGISTRATION 5.1 freezes the legacy arm as TANGO, AGGRESCAN, FoldAmyloid and ProA; 5.2 freezes the modern arm as AggreProt and AggrescanAI under a version-pinnable-and-local rule. A 2021 tool that has already succeeded on one of our rows belongs explicitly in one arm or in a named third category -- NOT left unmentioned, because it is the single strongest piece of evidence that the project's premise has a positive answer. _A_PATTERN_THE_WRITE_UP_MUST_NOT_HIDE: IN EVERY DISCORDANT CASE WHERE A PAPER RAN SEVERAL TOOLS, AT LEAST ONE TOOL SUCCEEDED. On DISC1 384-415, four of five legacy-era tools missed the linker and ANuPP (2021) hit it precisely, naming 387-395 and 400-415. On hnRNPA1 251-295, five of seven missed the core while WALTZ scored four true positives inside it and ZipperDB hit it alongside 85 false positives. THE HONEST STATEMENT IS NOT 'THE PREDICTORS FAIL' BUT 'THE WIDELY USED 2004-2010 GENERATION FAILS WHILE SCATTERED OTHER TOOLS SOMETIMES SUCCEED, WITHOUT CONSENSUS' -- which is close to Murray 2017's own phrasing for FUS, that the hitting tools showed 'no consensus on the identities of these segments'. A write-up that reports only the failures would be selective and would not survive review. This also sharpens the real question: not whether prediction is impossible, but whether any tool succeeds RELIABLY ACROSS rows rather than sporadically on one.

_THE_SWEEP_LEADS_THIS_PAPER_HANDS_US.A_TYPO_INVERTS_THE_MEANING_OF_ALL_THREE_: WITHDRAWN THE SAME DAY -- I OVERSTATED THIS AND THE CORRECTION MATTERS MORE THAN THE CLAIM. A search of ref 28 (Liberta 2019, AA amyloidosis) reports, at SNIPPET level, that the N-terminal ~21 residues -- described as the most hydrophobic and amyloidogenic stretch -- ARE crucial for building the fibril structure. If that holds, the sentence is LITERALLY TRUE for that reference and 'Related conclusions' means 'related comparisons were made', not 'the same conclusion was reached'. _THE_SWEEP_LEADS_THIS_PAPER_HANDS_US.note: These are systemic amyloidoses, not psychiatric proteins. CLAUDE.md's widening task is explicitly 'every protein with fragment-level aggregation mapping -- not only the psychiatric ones', so they are in scope.
_THE_SWEEP_LEADS_THIS_PAPER_HANDS_US._LIBERTA_2019_MAY_BE_CONCORDANT_NOT_DISC: WRONG, AND NOW RESOLVED BY READING THE PRIMARY. I guessed from a search summary that Liberta 2019 might be CONCORDANT, because the summary said the 'most amyloidogenic' segment IS the core. THE PAPER RUNS NO PREDICTOR AT ALL, so it is neither concordant nor discordant and the guess was meaningless. The phrase I was reading is 'the N-terminal ~21 residues of the fibril proteins, THE MOST HYDROPHOBIC AND AMYLOIDOGENIC SEGMENT of the protein sequence and a driver of systemic AA amyloidosis28-30' -- and refs 28-30 are EXPERIMENTAL work (CD spectroscopy of murine SAA proteins; 'The N-terminal segment of protein AA determines its fibrillogenic property'; a C-terminal truncation study), NOT predictions. 'Amyloidogenic' there means EXPERIMENTALLY amyloidogenic. TWO LESSONS. (1) 'Amyloidogenic' in this literature is ambiguous between measured and predicted, and the distinction is the whole basis of our stratum column -- read the citation, never the adjective. (2) BOTH of my readings of the Sharma sentence were wrong: it is not a dropped negation AND it is not supported as written, because the paper it cites contains no predictions to match or mismatch. The citation is simply loose.
_THE_SWEEP_LEADS_THIS_PAPER_HANDS_US.THE_SWEEP_RULE_THIS_TAUGHT_US: BEFORE ASSIGNING A STRATUM FROM A PAPER, CHECK THAT THE PAPER RAN A PREDICTOR. Two of the three leads handed to us by Sharma 2023 appear not to. A cryo-EM structure paper is a source of CLEAN rows by default and a source of STRATUM assignments only when it happens to include a post-hoc predictor comparison -- which is the exception, not the rule. The cheap discordant rows come specifically from the subset of structure papers that bothered to run the tools and say so.

_A_WHOLE_PROTEIN_CORE_CANNOT_TEST_A_WIND.finding: EXCLUSION WITH A REASON, NOT A GAP. The ex vivo ALECT2 structure (PMC13247027) reports that 'All 133 residues of the mature LECT2 protein are incorporated into the fibril structure.'
_A_WHOLE_PROTEIN_CORE_CANNOT_TEST_A_WIND.why_it_is_excluded: THERE IS NO REGION TO SCORE. A benchmark that asks whether a predictor ranks the aggregation-critical region ABOVE other windows of the same protein requires a negative class. If the ordered core is the entire sequence, every window is in the positive class, specificity is undefined, and every predictor scores identically well by construction. The paper's own predictor comparison shows the problem: it ran WALTZ, TANGO, Aggrescan and AmylPred, but because the core spans everything, its overlap statement cannot be a per-tool test.
_A_WHOLE_PROTEIN_CORE_CANNOT_TEST_A_WIND.the_general_rule_this_sets: ANY FIBRIL WHOSE ORDERED CORE IS THE WHOLE PROTEIN IS UNINFORMATIVE FOR THIS BENCHMARK AND MUST BE EXCLUDED WITH THIS REASON STATED. That is a premise audit in CLAUDE.md rule 3's sense -- the proposed comparison is impossible, and saying so IS the finding. Record such structures in the dataset if wanted, but never in the scored set.
_A_WHOLE_PROTEIN_CORE_CANNOT_TEST_A_WIND.it_also_undercuts_the_companion_row: The same paper is the source of the ex vivo conflict recorded on LECT2 55-75. Both facts come from patient material and both weaken the recombinant row.

_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.the_question: CLAUDE.md asks: do modern predictors recover the experimentally mapped regions the 2004-2010 generation missed, AND IF NOT, WHAT STRUCTURAL FEATURE ARE THEY ALL MISSING? The second half has had no candidate answer until now. The compositional answer was retired on 16 Nov (PREREGISTRATION 9.1).
_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.the_candidate: NATIVE STRUCTURAL CONTEXT DECIDES WHICH PREDICTED APRs CAN ACTUALLY ENGAGE, AND A SEQUENCE-ONLY PREDICTOR CANNOT SEE IT.
_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.evidence_1_LECT2: Richards 2023 argues exactly this, unprompted: 'While a significant fraction of the LECT2 sequence is predicted to be amyloidogenic, much of the protein's globular fold is stabilized by three disulfide bonds, two in the N-terminal region and one in C-terminal region. THESE BONDS WOULD LIKELY PREVENT MANY OF THE PREDICTED AMYLOIDOGENIC REGIONS FROM ASSEMBLING INTO FIBRILS. However, the core segment identified here is NOT INVOLVED IN ANY OF THE NATIVE DISULFIDE BONDS.' So the core is not the best-predicted segment -- it is the predicted segment that is structurally FREE.
_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.evidence_2_hnRNPA1: Sharma 2023 reports the converse from the other side: the predictors 'consistently identify segments within the two RRMs' -- i.e. inside FOLDED DOMAINS -- while the actual core forms in the LCD. APRs sequestered inside a folded domain are exactly the ones that cannot engage.
_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.why_this_is_worth_more_than_the_composit: IT IS NOT PRE-EMPTED. Murray 2017, Seuma 2021 and Mandelkow 2007 between them retired the compositional strand. None of them addresses structural sequestration. It is also MECHANISTIC rather than descriptive, it explains a FALSE-POSITIVE pattern rather than only a miss, and it predicts something checkable.
_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.how_it_could_be_tested_cheaply_and_the_h: The testable form is: across the discordant rows, do the predictors' top-ranked segments fall preferentially in regions that are structurally constrained in the native state (disulfide-bonded, buried, or inside a folded domain), while the true core falls in an unconstrained region? That needs a native structure or a confident disorder/burial annotation per row. WE HAVE IT FOR SOME ROWS AND NOT OTHERS -- LECT2 has PDB 5B0H and a published per-residue solvent accessibility (Figure S8B), hnRNPA1 has defined RRMs, FUS-LC is wholly disordered so the hypothesis makes NO prediction there, and DISC1 and TRIOBP-1 have no experimental structure at all. SO IT CANNOT BE TESTED ON THE ROWS THE PROJECT EXISTS FOR, WHICH IS A SERIOUS LIMIT AND MUST BE STATED BEFORE ANYONE INVESTS IN IT.
_A_CANDIDATE_ANSWER_TO_CLAUDE_MDs_HEADLI.what_must_NOT_happen: This must not be adopted as the project's new headline the way the gatekeeper claim was. The gatekeeper claim became a spine on n=1 and had to be retired four days later. THIS IS A HYPOTHESIS WITH NO MEASUREMENT BEHIND IT, FROM TWO PAPERS' DISCUSSION SECTIONS. If it enters PREREGISTRATION it enters as a pre-specified secondary analysis with its own falsification condition, AFTER the author decides it is worth the space.

_THE_LEGACY_ARM_RUN_ON_TRIOBP_1_IS_PUBLI.the_consensus_rule_verbatim: 'Putative aggregated regions were defined as stretches of 5 or more consecutive amino acids which were each predicted to have aggregation propensity by at least 3 of these 6 methods based on the thresholds listed above.' Bradshaw 2014 specifies threshold 21.4 at the same host with 'default parameters'. SAME THRESHOLD AND SAME HOST, ARRIVED AT INDEPENDENTLY -- and Murray names the defaults that Bradshaw leaves implicit. Together they pin the 5.1 reimplementation target from two directions. Both hosts return 000 today; this is the specification, not the server.

The 652-aa frame was introduced in the 2017 paper, which notes that 'many other publications' use 593 and that conversion is minus 59. The 2014 Methods give no accession for the analysed sequence and no frame. SO THE aa 230-236 QUOTED IN 2017 COULD BE EITHER FRAME. _A_DOCUMENTED_FALSE_POSITIVE_ON_OUR_OWN_.finding: THE PREDICTORS' ONLY BETA-SHEET CALL ON TRIOBP-1 WAS THE PH DOMAIN, AND IT WAS EXPERIMENTALLY REFUTED IN THE SAME PAPER.
_A_DOCUMENTED_FALSE_POSITIVE_ON_OUR_OWN_.the_prediction: 'Bioinformatics analysis suggested two potential mechanisms for TRIOBP-1 aggregation (figures 2B & 2C) either through alpha-helix-based aggregation of its coiled-coil C-terminus or through beta-sheet-based aggregation of its predicted Pleckstrin homology domain.'
_A_DOCUMENTED_FALSE_POSITIVE_ON_OUR_OWN_.the_refutation: A GFP-TRIOBP-1 construct with the PH domain deleted was built and tested: 'No difference in aggregation propensity was detected through either visualisation of the GFP signal by microscopy (figure 5A) or through Western blotting of purified cell aggregomes (figure 5B).' Confirmed in a second cell type: 'both the full length TRIOBP-1 and TRIOBP-1-deltaPH aggregated when over-expressed in CL4 epithelial cells'. The Discussion states the conclusion: 'The alternative, aggregation occurring through the interaction of beta-strands, is seemingly discounted as deletion of THE ONLY REGION OF THE TRIOBP-1 PROTEIN WITH A PREDICTED BETA-STRAND, the Pleckstrin homology domain, has no effect on the aggregation propensity of over-expressed protein.'
_A_DOCUMENTED_FALSE_POSITIVE_ON_OUR_OWN_.WHY_THIS_IS_A_THIRD_INSTANCE_OF_THE_STRU: It is the same shape as hnRNPA1 and LECT2, and this time ON THE PROJECT'S OWN PROTEIN. hnRNPA1: predictors 'consistently identify segments within the two RRMs' -- folded domains -- while the core forms in the LCD. LECT2: three disulfides 'would likely prevent many of the predicted amyloidogenic regions from assembling', and the real core is the one segment not disulfide-bonded. _A_NAME_SEARCH_IS_NOT_AN_ACCESSION_SEARC: FOUND BY MAKING THE MISTAKE, 17 Nov 2026. While screening candidate proteins, a keyword search for 'beta-2 microglob' returned ABSENT for P61769 -- which is wrong. Beta-2 microglobulin carries 72 rows in the CPAD peptide table and 34 in the structures table. CPAD writes it 'Beta2-microglobulin', with no hyphen in the position the query assumed. || WHY THIS IS NOT JUST A TYPO. The CPAD peptide table carries UniProt accessions, so membership there can be settled exactly. THE APR PROTEIN LIST AND THE STRUCTURES TABLE CARRY NO ACCESSION. For those two, a name match is the only instrument available, and a name match can fail silently in the direction that matters -- reporting ABSENT for a protein that is present. || WHAT WAS DONE ABOUT IT. The two load-bearing verdicts were re-tested with a normalised matcher that strips all non-alphanumeric characters, across 5 name variants for DISC1 and 7 for TRIOBP-1. Both remain ABSENT. The same matcher was run on four proteins KNOWN to be present -- serum amyloid A, lysozyme, beta-2 microglobulin, transthyretin -- and found all four, so the instrument is demonstrably sensitive and the negatives are not an artefact of a weak query. || THE STANDING RULE: check membership by ACCESSION wherever the table offers one, and where it does not, normalise the name, try several variants, AND RUN POSITIVE CONTROLS THROUGH THE SAME QUERY. An absence is only as good as the demonstrated sensitivity of the search that produced it.
_A_HYDROPHOBIC_SEGMENT_THAT_IS_NOT_IN_TH: A GENERAL SCORING RULE, DISCOVERED 17 Nov 2026 WHILE ADDING THE GLYCININ ROW, AND IT APPLIES TO EVERY ROW. Under 3.1, v depends on how many windows ELSEWHERE IN THE SCORED CHAIN outscore the region. So any segment that is hydrophobic for a reason other than aggregation -- a signal peptide, a transmembrane helix, a signal anchor -- acts as a decoy that inflates v and makes a predictor look worse than it is. Predictors score such segments highly and are RIGHT to. The choice of frame therefore sets the decoy pool, which is a second sense in which a frame choice is a scoring choice.
